photograph.author: Fayhoo
photograph.pixel_coordinates: Top left pixel centre is (0,0). The boundary lies halfway between the last sky and first tile pixel. Five original columns give the median boundary.
photograph.blue_sky_rule: B-R>25 and B-G>7. Seven consecutive non-sky samples below, three blue above (two accepted if no fully blue transition).
photograph.camera_calibration: 16 attic-glass corners in garden-camera.json. The roof slope sampling uses the same photograph and camera, at additional pixels.
photograph.selection: Seven fixed interior columns on each upper slope. No chosen column was an endpoint used to construct the roof.

method: Project the entire scene. Intersect each projected triangle with one fixed image column and find its earliest upper boundary. Independently cast camera rays 0.05 pixels above and below that boundary and one pixel inside to identify the nearest 3-D triangle.
